newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares fall, market awaits annual results.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares fall, market awaits annual results.

text.p: Norwegian shares slipped on Tuesday following the overnight slide on Wall Street and because the market is cautiously awaiting a flurry of annual results, dealers said.

Oslo's Total index fell 0.83 percent to 1,071.24 points in healthy turnover worth 983 million crowns. The Oslo Bourse experienced a liquidity-driven bull run throughout January, but February has seen more hesitant sentiments.
"Some companies have a lot to live up to," one broker said.
Metals maker Elkem shares rose 2.08 percent to 98 crowns after the company reported 1996 profits that met market expectations.
Among companies to present results this week are Den norske Bank (DnB), energy group Hafslund, shipping company Bergesen, forestry group Norske Skogindustrier and Union Bank of Norway (UBN).
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, which has a 20 percent weighting on the Total index, fell 1.7 percent to 366 crowns and was the most traded share at 96 million crowns.
